references.text: Kiriath-jearim is mentioned as one of the cities of the Gibeonites, the same city called Kiriath-baal here
Kiriath-baal, which is Kiriath-jearim, is mentioned as a border town for Judah and Benjamin
Kiriath-jearim is confirmed as the southern boundary of Benjamin, the same city as Kiriath-baal
Kiriath-jearim is mentioned in connection with where the ark of the covenant was kept
Kiriath-jearim is mentioned as the place where the ark of the covenant was located before it was brought by David
The ark of the covenant was brought to Kiriath-jearim and kept there for twenty years
David brought the ark of the covenant from Kiriath-jearim, also called Baalah
Kiriath-jearim is mentioned in the genealogy of Caleb as one of the cities founded by his descendants
